description:
Using the TitanicSurvival dataset (already loaded or located at '~/Documents/Jamovi/TitanicSurvival.csv'), perform a Chi-Square Test of Independence to examine the association between 'passengerClass' and 'survived'.

1. Open '~/Documents/Jamovi/TitanicSurvival.csv' if not already open.
2. Ensure 'passengerClass' and 'survived' are set as Nominal variables.
3. Run a Chi-Square Test of Association (Analyses > Frequencies > Independent Samples).
4. Set 'passengerClass' as Rows and 'survived' as Columns.
5. Enable 'Expected counts', 'Row percentages', and 'Cramér\'s V'.
6. Save the project as '~/Documents/Jamovi/TitanicChiSquare.omv'.
7. Create a text report at '~/Documents/Jamovi/chisquare_report.txt' containing the Chi-square statistic, Degrees of freedom, p-value, and Cramér\'s V.
